name: env-rejector
description: Denies Read, Bash and Grep access to .env files and strips .env hits from Grep results, so secrets stay out of the model's context.

commitWrapper.title: Commit wrapper pattern
commitWrapper.description: Regular expression matched against each line of a Bash command. A matching line is treated like `git commit`: its quoted arguments are commit-message text, and its repository is the one named by its `-C <dir>`, else a leading `cd`, else the session's directory. Empty: only `git commit` is recognized.
